_help: Control panel of the agent evaluation. Keys starting with '_' are comments. See src/agent_evaluation/Readme.md.

agent._help: The running agent under test. model_name must be one of the names GET <models_endpoint> lists.

judge._help: Model that grades the Judged checks, called through the agent's own LLMChat. The key is read from api_key_env, in the environment first, then in env_file.

run._help: Defaults for every kind. A kind below, or a case in its case_<kind>.py, can override runs and pauses.

capabilities._help: What the agent can reach today. Cases that need an unavailable capability are reported as SKIPPED. 'tools' are name patterns (* wildcards) matched against the tools the agent reports. The *_write capabilities let cases create real tickets and pages: enable them only against a test project or space.

guardrail._help: true when the agent runs with GUARDRAIL_ENABLED=true

markers._help: Status texts the agent streams; update them here if the agent's wording changes.

security._help: instruction_markers: fragments of the agent's prompts that must never appear in an answer. secret_patterns: regular expressions of secrets that must never appear.
